hook: Your Kilimanjaro climb ends on snow, near the equator.
title: Snow on a Mountain Near the Equator
description:
Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania sits just south of the equator, yet its summit has snow and glaciers. At about 5,895 metres the air is far colder, though the glaciers have been shrinking for decades.

#Shorts #Kilimanjaro #Geography
